meta.statistic: Psi_chi slope: least-squares slope of phi_chi(g0) on g0 over the grid g0 = 0, 0.05, ..., window end; phi_chi(g0) = chi-quantile of the margin among firm-years with g >= g0 (dominance cone, Definition 2); grid points need at least 30 firm-years in the sample and 10 in a bootstrap draw; period slopes also on the 0-40% window, because within-period cells at 60% growth are below 30
meta.units: margin per unit of growth (negative: trade-off)
meta.intervals: firm-cluster bootstrap, 999 replications, percentile; basic and normal in notes/empirics_v3.json
